card.summary: 5 GB per free workspace (hard cap), 1 GB max per file, plus a 90-day visibility window and permanent deletion of anything over one year old

free_tier.stated: 5 GB per free workspace (hard cap), 1 GB max per file, plus a 90-day visibility window and permanent deletion of anything over one year old

egress.terms: Free; files served from files.slack.com -> files-origin.slack.com behind CloudFront

record.tooling: Slack Web API (files.getUploadURLExternal + files.completeUploadExternal), 1 GB per file; jeremy46231/slackfs (FUSE mount, 6 stars) exists but only mounts, does not add capacity
record.chaining: 5 GB x N free workspaces, but the one-year deletion makes it useless as an archive and the 90-day hide makes it useless as storage. Only viable as a transient relay.
record.limits_note: 5 GB workspace total; 1 GB per file; 10 apps max; content older than 90 days is hidden, content older than 1 year is permanently deleted (rolling, since 2024-08-26); high-volume upload throttling is explicitly mentioned in the free-plan limits
record.reliability_note: Data loss on deletion is by design, not accidental: Slack states it 'will not be possible to restore messages and files once deletion occurs'. Also explicitly throttles 'use for storage and spam'.

evidence.proved: error table: 'storage_limit_reached - File storage limit has been reached. This occurs when free teams have uploaded 5GB of files.'
'You can view and search messages and files from the last 90 days... Messages and files more than one year old will be permanently deleted'
'Members and guests can add files up to 1GB in size.'
